mainEntity.name: How much does a Mercedes CLA 35 AMG engine replacement cost in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Mercedes CLA 35 AMG replacement engine typically costs between £2,200 for a used M260 unit and £6,000 for a fully rebuilt engine. Specialist fitting adds £600-£1,000 due to the complexity of the 4MATIC system. Used M260 DE20 LA engines: £2,200-£3,500 depending on mileage and condition. Reconditioned M260 units: £3,500-£5,000 supply only. Rebuilt M260 units: £4,500-£6,000 supply only. Specialist fitting adds £600-£1,000; dealer labour is significantly higher. 12-month warranty included on all rebuilt units through EnginesMarket.

mainEntity.name: Is the Mercedes CLA 35 AMG engine reliable? What problems should I watch for?

acceptedAnswer.text: The M260 DE20 LA engine in the CLA 35 AMG has developed a reputation for premature cylinder head wear - particularly exhaust valve seat and guide failure - often at mileages as low as 25,000-50,000 miles. Oil consumption and timing chain tensioner issues have also been reported. Cylinder head wear is the most significant issue affecting the M260 engine family. Symptoms include misfires, loss of compression, starting problems and engine management lights. Oil consumption due to piston ring wear can occur from 40,000 miles. Timing chain rattling on cold start signals imminent tensioner failure. Regular oil changes every 10,000 miles are critical for engine longevity. Warning: Cylinder head failure on the CLA 35 AMG can occur outside warranty - many owners report failures at 19,000-50,000 miles.

mainEntity.name: How long do Mercedes CLA 35 AMG engines last?

acceptedAnswer.text: With proper maintenance, the M260 DE20 LA engine can reach 100,000-150,000 miles. However, cylinder head failures reported at 25,000-50,000 miles suggest some units may fail prematurely due to manufacturing defects. Cylinder head failure can occur as early as 19,000-50,000 miles. Well-maintained units without cylinder head defects: 100,000-150,000 miles possible. Regular oil changes every 10,000 miles (not Mercedes' 15,000-18,000 mile interval) significantly extends life.

mainEntity.name: Which Mercedes CLA 35 AMG engine should I avoid when buying used?

acceptedAnswer.text: All CLA 35 AMG models use the same M260 DE20 LA engine. The key consideration is whether the cylinder head has been replaced with the improved version. Early 2019-2021 models appear to have the highest failure rates. 2019-2021 CLA 35 AMG: highest reported cylinder head failure rates. 2022+ models: improved cylinder head design fitted from factory in some cases. Always check service history for regular oil changes using Mercedes-approved oil. Ask if the cylinder head has been replaced - if not, budget for potential replacement.

mainEntity.name: How much does cylinder head replacement cost on a Mercedes CLA 35 AMG?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cylinder head replacement on a CLA 35 AMG M260 engine costs £3,500-£5,000 at a specialist or £5,000-£7,000 at a main dealer. If bottom-end damage has occurred, full engine replacement at £5,000-£7,500 is required. Specialist cylinder head replacement: £3,500-£5,000 including parts and labour. Dealer pricing for same work: £5,000-£7,000. The cylinder head job is approximately 19 hours of labour. If cylinder head failure has caused bottom-end damage, full engine replacement is required.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine on a Mercedes CLA 35 AMG?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A CLA 35 AMG is worth £25,000-£35,000 - a rebuilt engine at £5,000-£7,500 represents roughly 15-20% of the car's value, making replacement economically justifiable for a car in otherwise good condition. CLA 35 AMG with good body/interior: replacement engine is cost-effective. Specialist rebuilt engines fix original design weaknesses and include warranty. Compare against £7,000-£9,500 main dealer new engine quotes.

mainEntity.name: Mercedes CLA 35 AMG vs CLA 45 AMG - is the engine the same?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The CLA 35 AMG uses the M260 DE20 LA engine (306 hp, 400 Nm), while the CLA 45 AMG uses the M133 (first-generation) or M139 (second-generation) engine with significantly higher power output (360-421 hp). They are not interchangeable. CLA 35 AMG: M260 DE20 LA, 306 hp, 400 Nm. CLA 45 AMG (2015-2019): M133, 360-381 hp - different engine family. CLA 45 S AMG (2019+): M139, 421 hp - hand-built AMG engine. Engine codes, mounting points and electronics are not compatible between the two.

commonProblems.h2: Mercedes CLA 35 AMG Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The Mercedes-AMG CLA 35 is powered exclusively by the M260 DE20 LA 2.0-litre turbocharged engine - a high-performance variant of the M260 family shared with the A35 AMG. While this engine delivers impressive performance, it has developed a reputation for premature cylinder head wear, with reports of exhaust valve seat and guide failure at relatively low mileages. Oil consumption and timing chain tensioner issues have also been reported. Every rebuilt engine supplied through EnginesMarket includes upgraded components designed to address the original failure point - plus a minimum 12-month unlimited mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Cylinder Head Wear - Exhaust Valve Seat Failure in the M260 DE20 LA
problems.rootCause: The exhaust valve seats and valve guides in the M260 engine can wear prematurely, allowing excessive valve movement and loss of compression. This is a well-documented manufacturing defect affecting the M260 engine family across Mercedes-Benz models including the A35 AMG, CLA 35 AMG, GLA 35 AMG, and GLB 35 AMG. Symptoms include loss of compression on one or more cylinders, starting problems, frequent stalling, and the engine management light illuminating. Some owners have reported cylinder head failure at as little as 19,000 miles.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace cylinder head with improved version, new valve train components, gaskets and bolts
Supply & fit fully rebuilt M260 DE20 LA engine with upgraded cylinder head components, bench tested, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: 50,000+ miles or when cylinder head failure has caused bottom-end damage

problems.recommendation: Cylinder head failure is the single most significant issue affecting the M260 DE20 LA engine in CLA 35 AMG models. If you experience misfires, loss of power, or engine management lights, get a compression test immediately. If caught early, cylinder head replacement at £3,500-£5,000 from a specialist resolves the issue. However, if the failure has been ignored and bottom-end damage has occurred, full rebuilt engine replacement at £5,000-£7,500 is the only safe option.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt M260 DE20 LA Mercedes CLA 35 AMG engine prices

problems.h4: Oil Consumption & Piston Ring Wear - M260 High-Performance Oil Burning
problems.rootCause: Worn piston rings allow oil to enter the combustion chamber, leading to excessive oil consumption, blue exhaust smoke, and reduced engine compression. The high-performance nature of the M260 engine - with its 8.6:1 compression ratio and 306 hp output - places additional stress on piston rings and cylinder walls. A faulty crankcase vent valve can also contribute to oil consumption by allowing pressure to build up in the crankcase.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Full engine strip, replace piston rings, hone cylinders, new gaskets and bolts
repairOptions.longevity: 40,000-70,000 miles; labour-intensive but retains original engine block

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit fully rebuilt engine with upgraded piston rings designed to prevent recurrence. Bench tested, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: 70,000+ miles or when oil consumption exceeds 1L/1,000 miles

problems.recommendation: On a CLA 35 AMG burning oil excessively, we typically recommend full rebuilt engine replacement rather than just piston rings. The labour to strip and rebuild is almost identical, but a factory-rebuilt unit includes all new bearings, seals, and timing components - and the upgraded rings that fix the design weakness. The price difference is often just £1,000-£2,000, and the rebuilt engine comes with a 12-month warranty.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt M260 DE20 LA Mercedes CLA 35 AMG engine prices

problems.h4: Timing Chain Tensioner Failure - Rattling on Cold Start
problems.rootCause: The timing chain tensioner can lose hydraulic pressure, allowing the chain to slacken and produce a rattling or slapping noise on cold start. If ignored, a stretched or damaged timing chain can cause catastrophic engine failure. Some CLA 35 AMG owners have reported timing chain tensioner replacement as part of wider engine work.

repairOptions.longevity: Effective if caught early; tensioner replacement only

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace timing chain, tensioner, guides and sprockets
Supply & fit fully rebuilt engine with upgraded timing components, bench tested, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Required if chain has slipped and valves have contacted pistons

problems.recommendation: Rattling on cold start for 1-2 seconds is the early warning sign of timing chain tensioner failure. Don't ignore it - specialist tensioner replacement at £500-£800 or full timing chain replacement at £1,400-£1,900 resolves the issue if done promptly. If you've been driving with the rattle for months, the chain has almost certainly stretched, and we'd advise moving straight to a rebuilt engine with upgraded timing components.
